propositions: Pass-1 finder (which generates blocking findings for claims) was silently downgraded from frontier/opus to trivial/haiku after b690 landed, because PydanticAIRunner.run now honours req.config which declares trivial in the model_ladder.
The regression is undetectable in offline tests because the test suite substitutes FunctionModel/FakeRunner, missing the exact change: which live model the runner calls.

Prior to 2026-06-27, Pass-1 produced findings on opus (115 recorded reviews); after 2026-06-28 it switched permanently to sonnet (2,710+ runs), a total changeover one day after _verifier_cfg introduced the verifier downgrade.

_verifier_cfg's docstring falsely claims Pass-1 is unaffected by the verifier downgrade and runs the YAML model_ladder, but until b690 landed, req.config was discarded so no ladder rung influenced Pass-1 at all.

The fix is to restore plan-review.yaml model_ladder rung 0 from trivial to frontier, making _verifier_cfg's docstring claim true and pass-1 findings generate on opus as they did before the regression.
Prerequisite finder's bin packing now sizes to haiku's 200k window instead of sonnet/opus's 1M window, causing spurious context-limit escalations that burn tokens unnecessarily.
